cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You showed me the rescue dog's photo, not the page saying he eats sofas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needed a home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I understand. Admit that hiding the sofa page changed my yes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy you another sofa.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Before we feed him another one, say I should have had both pages.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you back 'collecting chairs' when the caretaker asks why we opened the props cupboard? We need him to lend us the hall again. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Chairs don't fit in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Checking for folding stools, then. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign the hall request with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you back 'collecting chairs' when the caretaker asks why we opened the props cupboard? We need him to lend us the hall again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Chairs don't fit in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Checking for folding stools, then. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign the hall request with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you approve 'delivery delay' in the newsletter? I don't want our new volunteer blamed for the melted cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'storage problem'. Will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Can I put your name under it?

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My office doesn't lock either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My office doesn't lock either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.
